name: 53-display-position
css:
body { margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: "builtin_song"; font-size: 17px; } p { margin: 6px 0; line-height: 1.6; } .inl { display: inline-block; width: 120px; height: 34px; background-color: #eef; } .blk { display: block; width: 160px; height: 24px; background-color: #efe; } .rel { position: relative; left: 18px; top: 6px; background-color: #ffe; } .abs { position: absolute; top: 12px; left: 220px; width: 90px; background-color: #fee; }
 .abs2 { position: absolute; right: 12px; bottom: 16px; width: 80px; background-color: #efe; }
html:
行内块对照：inline-block 120×34 结束

display:block 160×24

position:relative 偏移 18/6

absolute 定位 220/12
absolute right/bottom

绝对定位之后的普通段落，观察它是否被摘出常规流。
